name: italian-quiz-data
title_zh: 改意大利语语法测验题，先懂这套 md 转 data
tagline_zh: 你改的是 scheda 还是 soluzioni？build 脚本怎么不重写你的进度？这套模块布局讲清楚。
tagline_en: Editing scheda or soluzioni? How does the build script preserve your progress? This layout map keeps quiz edits.
desc_en: Use when building, extending, or debugging the Italian-grammar quiz webapp for this folder ("Italiensk grammatik") — i.e. when the user mentions the quiz app, förhör/quiz i italienska, webapp/, data.js, build_quiz_data.py, the md/ folder, scheda-filerna, soluzioni-filerna, or parsing exercises/facit from the transcribed markdown files. Explains the modular file layout, context-saving guidelines fo
why_zh: 它把分散的 md 转录、解析脚本和 data.js 串成一条可追溯的链，改哪里、会波及谁，一眼看穿。
why_en: It links scattered md transcripts, parser scripts, and data.js into one traceable chain—see what changes and what breaks, no.
limit_zh: 只服务本仓库的意大利语语法测验应用；不生成新题、不校验语法正确性，只解释现有文件结构和构建流程。超出此范围它帮不上忙。
limit_en: Only for this repo's Italian grammar quiz app. It explains file layout and build flow—it won't create new questions or check grammar accuracy.
title_en: Italian quiz editor: md→data pipeline explained
